Quirk Form: Active.description:
🔄 Your transformation is active: your body hits and holds harder.

📈 Striking +10, Blocking +10, Conditioning +10, Quirk Output +5
⚠️ Fights only. Costs 4 Stamina a turn; drops when the fight ends, at 10 Stamina, at Quirk Strain 100%, when you go down, or when you end it.
Quirk Form: Active.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's transformation is active, exactly as their Quirk card describes: the body changed, hitting and holding harder, costing stamina every turn and showing its limits and Drawback. Erasure or exhaustion ends it.
